claims.claim: Management expects 5%+ Advanced Connectivity service-revenue growth and 6%+ EBITDA growth for 2026, while acknowledging near-term fiber ARPU pressure from convergence and acquired lower-ARPU Lumen subscribers.

Management raised expected 2026 share repurchases to about $10B while expecting leverage to rise after the EchoStar spectrum transaction, making cash conversion and leverage control key execution checks.

risks: capital returns compete with deleveraging and network investment
contradictions: Management is accelerating buybacks while also preparing for higher post-transaction leverage; both can be rational only if free-cash-flow durability holds.
unknowns: whether convergence lifetime value offsets ARPU discounts

recommendation.reason: Execution expectations are source-addressed and expose falsifiable leverage, growth and convergence checkpoints.
